props.title: What Is a Foot Massage?
props.text: A foot massage works the muscles and soft tissues of the feet and lower legs with warm oil and some pressure techniques borrowed from reflexology. It eases the tension that builds up from walking, standing and travelling, which makes it a popular choice after a long day exploring Bali.
props.feature1Text: Helps reduce fatigue caused by walking, standing, and everyday activities.
props.feature2Text: Combines relaxing massage with pressure point techniques for added comfort.

props.title: Choose the Right Duration
props.text: One hour covers tired feet; 1.5 or 2 hours leave more time for the ankles, calves and lower legs. The pressure is adjusted to your comfort in every session.

props.title: When a Foot Massage Helps Most
props.text: A foot massage is most welcome after a long day of walking, standing or travelling. Guests often book one for:
featuresLeft: Tired feet after sightseeing or exploring
Sore arches or heels after extended walking
Foot fatigue following a long flight
featuresRight: Tired feet after standing for several hours
Muscle fatigue after light physical activities

props.title: Areas We Focus On
props.text: The massage covers the parts of the feet and lower legs that tire most during the day:
featuresRight: Calf muscles that can contribute to foot tension
Toes and the surrounding soft tissues

props.title: How Our Foot Massage Is Performed
props.text: Our foot massage uses a combination of gentle techniques to work through tension in the feet and lower legs. Warm natural oils help create smooth, comfortable movements, while focused pressure is applied to areas that may feel particularly tired after walking or standing. The treatment can be tailored to your comfort, with techniques such as:
featuresLeft: Warm oil for smooth massage movements
Reflexology-inspired pressure on key foot zones
featuresRight: Focused attention on the arches and heels
Massage of the lower legs and calves
Pressure adjusted to your comfort level

items.question: Is a foot massage the same as reflexology?
items.answer: Not exactly. A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon focuses on relaxing muscles, relieving soreness and improving comfort throughout the feet and lower legs. Reflexology traditionally follows pressure points believed to correspond with different parts of the body. Our treatment uses selected reflexology-inspired techniques while remaining a relaxing massage experience.

items.question: Can a foot massage help after walking all day?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book a foot massage at Spa Bali Moon after sightseeing, shopping or long walks around Bali, because it helps reduce tiredness and discomfort in the feet, arches, heels and calves.

items.question: Does a foot massage include the lower legs?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on the session you choose, your Spa Bali Moon therapist also massages the ankles and lower legs to ease muscle tightness connected to tired feet. Longer sessions of 1.5 or 2 hours give more time for the lower legs as well as the soles and heels.

items.question: Does a foot massage use strong pressure?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Your therapist adjusts the pressure to your comfort, from gentle to firmer, and you can ask for a change at any point during the session. A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon is meant to be soothing while still giving tired feet real relief, with warm natural oils and focused pressure on tired areas.

items.question: Can I have a foot massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen, oils and everything a foot massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Send your location and preferred time on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can a foot massage help my neuropathy?
items.answer: Foot massage may help relieve discomfort and promote relaxation, but it does not treat the underlying cause of neuropathy. If you have reduced sensation in your feet, speak with a healthcare professional before booking a massage, and tell your Spa Bali Moon therapist before the session so the pressure can be kept gentle and comfortable.

items.question: Can I have a foot massage if I have plantar fasciitis?
items.answer: Yes. Gentle massage of the soles and heels can ease tension and feel particularly soothing, but it does not replace professional treatment when symptoms persist. Tell your Spa Bali Moon therapist where it hurts before the session, so they can keep the pressure comfortable.

items.question: Can I get a foot massage while pregnant?
items.answer: Foot massage can be relaxing during pregnancy, but it is best to check with your healthcare provider first, especially if you have any pregnancy-related complications. Let your Spa Bali Moon therapist know that you are pregnant before the session starts, so they can adjust the treatment and the pressure accordingly.

items.question: Why does a foot massage feel so good?
items.answer: A foot massage can feel good because it relaxes tense muscles, stimulates the feet and promotes a sense of calm. The combination of gentle pressure, warm natural oils and soothing movements can also help reduce everyday stress.

items.question: How much does a foot massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 159.000 for 1 hour, IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 330.000 for 2 hours per person. For a shorter session, 30 minutes of foot reflexology is IDR 99.000. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How long does a foot massage take?
items.answer: A foot massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour (IDR 159.000), 1.5 hours (IDR 239.000) or 2 hours (IDR 330.000) per person.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my foot massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your foot massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
